entities.summary: Antonius Subianto Bunjamin OSC is an Indonesian Catholic prelate who has served as bishop of Bandung since 2014. He has also been the president of the Bishops' Conference of Indonesia since 2022, having previously served as its secretary general from 2015 to 2022.
